title: CourseDAO
tagline: A DAO that works together to improve the teaching curriculum.
description: A DAO that works together to improve the teaching curriculum.Anyone can initiate a Course DAO in their field.Anyone can initiate a course DAO in their field and invite partners in this field to create courses together.Once the course is created, anyone can learn it through a streaming subscription.In the process of learning or making proposals, users will also obtain the governance token of DAO through streaming payment.Anyone in the DAO can improve the course by way of proposals and receive continuous stream payment rewards.The project mainly uses SuperFluid to complete the flow payment of all funds to better motivate users to build a better course DAO.
how_its_made: The project mainly uses SuperFluid in smart contracts to complete the flow payment of all funds to better motivate users to build a better course DAO.Users can learn and improve courses in one of the DAOs, and obtain governance tokens every moment through streaming payment.And using web3storage of IPFS to save main data.The project mainly uses SuperFluid to complete the flow payment of all funds to better motivate users to build a better course DAO.
